India and Pakistan Exchange Prisoner Lists, India Seeks Repatriation

India and Pakistan have exchanged lists of prisoners as part of a routine agreement. India has specifically requested the repatriation of 188 of its nationals held in Pakistan and sought consular access for 13 Indian prisoners. This exchange is a regular diplomatic process between the two countries.
